topic: University of Banja Luka students' rallies in support of Serbia's student list banned by Republika Srpska police; students announce lawsuit
scale: planned rallies of 75-125 participants on Trg Krajine, banned twice
quote1: Authorities in the Brcko District filed misdemeanor charges against the students for holding an unannounced rally, while unconfirmed reports indicate that police in Doboj shut down their event.
quote2: Policija u Banjaluci zabranila je drugi skup podrške studentskoj listi iz Srbije, uz procjenu da bi okupljanje moglo ugroziti bezbjednost.
